chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The one among you who is longest in qunūt in the abode of this world will be the one among you with the longest rest on the Day of Resurrection at the Standing."

key_terms.قُنُوتاً: prolonged supplication and devotional standing in salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلْمَوْقِفِ: the place or moment of standing for judgment

ai.seo_question: How does prolonging qunūt in prayer benefit a believer on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of prolonging qunūt in salat (prayer), presenting it as an act that brings relief and ease on the Day of Resurrection. It connects devotion in worldly worship with comfort during the hardship of standing for reckoning in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1403 - The Messenger of Allah (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"The one who prolongs their Qunoot (supplication during prayer) the longest in this worldly life will be granted the longest rest on the Day of Resurrection at the Standing (before Allah (swt))”.
